subject: general
question: In October 2020, what was the name of the initiative launched by Indian Railways for the safety of its women passengers?
solution:
The correct answer is** **__**MERI SAHELI.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **‘Meri Saheli’** initiative was launched as **Pilot Project by Railway Protection Force (RPF)** across the South Eastern Railway to secure women passengers in trains originating in that zone.
 
• Meri Saheli Initiative was launched to** provide safety and security to lady passengers** travelling by trains for their entire journey from originating station to the terminating station.
 
• **Section 58 of the Railways Act, 1989 **provides for the earmarking of accommodation for female passengers in trains.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Indian railways came into existence long back in **1853 on 16 April.**
 
• The first passenger train ran between Mumbai’s Bori Bandar and Thane, covering 34 kilometres.
 
• Indian Railways is the world’s** 4th largest railway** network, followed by the US, China and Russia.
 
• India possesses the world’s **longest platform, 1,366** metres in length, at the **Gorakhpur Railway Station** in Uttar Pradesh.
 
• Indian Railway is constructing the** world’s highest rail arch bridge **with steel and concrete over the** Chenab river.**
 
• **Pir Pranjal **Is India’s Longest Rail Tunnel.
 
• Railway Zones and Divisions in The Country.
 
• At present, there are** 17 Railway Zones and 68 Divisions** in the country.
